description: Per-app environment config for TCOE (IDP IELTS Booking System). NEVER hardcode credentials here — reference environment variables (loaded from qe-pipeline/.env) by name only.
_urlNotes: SIT environment (per story TCOE-1356). appUrl = account login/signup, the flow start (sign up -> book). The booking wizard opens on https://bxsearch.ielts.sit.idp.com and account/booking pages on https://bx.ielts.sit.idp.com (both documented in the TCOE PKB navigation-map). The Planner may refine appUrl in Step 8. apiBaseUrl only for API-only stories. appUrl already satisfies the URL gate.

credentials.note: DO NOT hardcode credentials. Reference environment variables (loaded from qe-pipeline/.env) by name only.

endpoints._doc: Optional. Named API endpoint paths this app's tests hit, used by the execution health check to probe the SPECIFIC endpoint (not just the host).
